title: ChatGPT and Codex have made me a game. Need a couple of playtesters.
author: GunslingerX1983
selftext:
So I tasked ChatGPT to design a game for me that it thinks I would like based on our extensive conversations, my likes and interests. I did not want to know what the game was about before i first actual proper playthrough. 

I have spent the past few weeks passing zip files back and forth between my ChatGPT conversation and Codex doing the work. They have been acting as Project Director and Developer while I have been deemed "Executive Producer" or Tea boy generally.

  
Aside from the odd screenshot that has slipped through and the main menu I know nothing really but it has gotten to the point where it supposedly needs playtesting to see whether they have made anything work playing.

  
I have a packaged playtest version and questionnaire that I would like to see if i can ask a few people to try out and give feedback on. I will not read the feedback but pass it straight on to my "team" and see what they make of it.

Its a first person scifi lonely exploration & discovery game or something. That's all i know and has been made in Godot so it won't be a AAA experience.

  
If anyone would like to try then let me know how i can get it to you.

  
MODs if this is not allowed let me know please happy to change to meet requirements.

comments.author: Reasonable_Owl_3146
comments.body: AI is bad at designing games. As a helper it's lovely, but anything it comes up with all on its own will not be fun.

replies.author: GunslingerX1983
replies.body: Yeah i do strongly suspect that the "finished" game will still be a bit of a mess and I may question exactly what part of it is in fact the game... but it seemed like a fun little project.

comments.author: Candid_Coyote9881
comments.body: I don’t like you so why would I play a game you like

replies.author: GunslingerX1983
replies.body: Totally fair, I am not that likable.

replies.author: Candid_Coyote9881
replies.body: Okay so I will not check out the game. Life lesson advocate for yourself

comments.author: Agile_Branch_8743
comments.body: You can ask ChatGPT and Codex to test it, or pay testers to do it.

replies.author: GunslingerX1983
replies.body: Codex has tested it. My ChatGPT Director has seen it but says it cannot "play it". It wants a human viewpoint and opinion over what works and doesn't. I have to give it credit for at least recognising that rather than just claiming it plays great.

comments.author: kamilr641
comments.body: i'd put a free-response question near the start of the questionnaire: 'what did you think you were meant to do next?' That can show whether the game is communicating its objectives, before the other questions steer their feedback
